startMinutes.description: 결정·할 일·담당·기한을 남기는 회의록 · 촘촘한 회색 머리
startMinutes.example_prompt:
회의록을 정리해 줘. 정해진 것과 아직 정해지지 않은 것을 나누고, 실행 항목에는 담당자와 기한을 적어 줘.

회의와 참석자:
startMinutes.instructions:
Build this document with the **회의록** template. The title block and the layout are already set; write only the content. Each section is one `layout` plus that section's body HTML fragment. - `cover` — the title block. In one `

` line, state what the meeting was gathered to decide, then inside `

    ` write 일시·장소·참석·기록 one per line, like `
  • 일시 2026-08-18 (화) 10:00~11:05
    • `. This list stands vertically in the narrow column on the right of the document, so keep each line under 20 characters. - `section` — one agenda item, or a group of 결정 사항 or 실행 항목. Agenda numbers are added automatically, so do not write "1." in the title yourself. ## 오른쪽 눈금자 The backbone of this format is one column fixed vertically on the right of the document. In the title block the date and place, and in the body every owner and deadline, are pinned right-aligned in that column. All this format is for is that two months later, skimming just the right edge shows each person their own name and date. That is why 결정 사항 and 실행 항목 are written as `
      `, not paragraphs. One item looks like this.
    • 정해진 것 한 줄 왜 그렇게 정했는지 한두 문장. 정해원 · 8월 28일
      • - `` is the decision or the task itself in one line. It need not end with punctuation. - The sentences after it are grounds or conditions. If there are none, leave them out. - `` is the value that hangs on the ruler, one per `
    • `. In the form `담당 · 기한`, under 15 characters — short, like `정해원 · 8월 28일`, `이견 없음`, `전결 규정 §12`. A sentence there overflows the column into two or three lines. - If the owner or deadline was not decided in the meeting, write only 「미정」 in the value cell, like `미정 · 미정`, and put why it was not decided and when and who will decide it (e.g. 9월 7일까지 담당 지정) in the sentence before. If it is not in the material at all, leave it as brackets like `[담당자] · [기한]`. Write a deadline only as one of 날짜(요일)·「미정」·「[기한]」, and keep original wording such as 「다음 주 금요일까지」 in the sentence before. A line without `` is later read by no one as their own. Tables use the same ruler. With three or more columns, keep the last column for short values such as owner or deadline, and put long explanations in the earlier columns. ## 쓸 수 있는 것 The only allowed tags are `p, h3, ul, ol, li, strong, em, code, blockquote, table, thead, tbody, tr, th, td, small`. Do not use `

      ` — section titles are added separately. Use only the three `class` values `lead`, `meta`, `rows` above; any other tag, `style`, links and images are discarded. Wrap anything whose meaning survives only when copied **character for character** — commands, paths, identifiers, exception names — in ``. `` is a single fragment — this format has no multi-line code blocks, so if it is long, copy only the most important line and describe the rest in words. - Do not mix what was said with what was decided. Write discussion as paragraphs and decisions as `rows`. - Every action item must carry an owner and a deadline. If the meeting did not decide them, write "미정" to record that they were not decided; if they are not in the material, leave "[담당자]" "[기한]". - Do not write an agenda item with no conclusion as if it were concluded; state who decides it next and when. - Do not invent background that did not come up in the meeting. Leave unknown names and dates as brackets, like 「[담당자]」 「[일자]」. - Do not transcribe remarks verbatim; reduce them to what was argued. Use `
      ` only when the wording itself must be kept. ## 표·강조 수치·절차 The layout draws these three separately. The format controls size and color, so do not use `style`. - **강조 수치** — if two or three numbers are the conclusion of a section, write them inside `
      `, one `
      값이름
      ` per cell. At most 4. Keep values short, like `32%`, `1.4초`. Do not copy figures from a table — a table is for comparing, this block is for **making one thing remembered**. - **절차** — write steps done in order as `
        ` with `
      1. 이름 설명
        2. `. The layout adds the numbers, so do not write them. A branching flow is not a procedure. - **표** — write comparisons, figures and schedules as ``. 3–5 rows is right. ## 그래프 If the **shape** of the numbers is the point, write `
startMinutes.checklist:
- 일시·장소·참석자가 적혀 있는가. 오지 못한 사람이 이 문서만 읽고 따라올 수 있는가.
- 정해진 것과 논의만 된 것이 구분되는가. 섞여 있으면 나중에 둘 다 지켜지지 않는다.
- 결정마다 왜 그렇게 정했는지가 한 줄이라도 남아 있는가.
- 실행 항목에 사람 이름과 날짜가 있는가. "추후" 나 "관련 부서" 는 담당자가 아니다.
- 결정과 실행 항목의 오른쪽 칸이 한 줄도 비어 있지 않은가. 회의에서 미뤘다면 "미정"과 사유가, 자료에 없다면 "[담당자]" "[기한]"이 적혀 있는가.
- 오른쪽 칸에 문장이 아니라 이름과 날짜만 있는가. 길어지면 눈금이 흐트러진다.
- 결론이 나지 않은 안건에 대해, 다음에 누가 언제 정하는지 적혀 있는가.
- 반대나 유보 의견이 있었다면 그것도 남아 있는가.
- 회의에서 나오지 않은 내용이 끼어 있지 않은가.
